import redis.asyncio as redis

_queues: dict[str, list[str]] = {}


async def enqueue_song(room: str, song_id: str) -> None:
    _queues.setdefault(room, []).append(song_id)


async def next_song(room: str) -> str | None:
    queue = _queues.get(room)
    return queue.pop(0) if queue else None
